## Appendix figure: figN_1_motif2_gc_confound.png
```{r, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE, 'Appendix figure - figN_1_motif2_gc_confound.png'}

M <- PROJECT_DIR
pk <- read.csv(file.path(M,"data/chapter4/table4_ctrl_motif2_frequency.csv"), check.names=FALSE)
rownames(pk) <- pk$Factor
t <- read.csv(file.path(M,"data/motif2_attribution/pooled_attribution_tests.csv"))
p <- t[t$comparison=="enhancers bound by pooled vs unbound",]
n <- read.csv(file.path(M,"data/motif2_attribution/nonenh_baseline.csv"))
gcf <- function(f){ L <- readLines(f, warn=FALSE); s <- paste(L[!grepl("^>",L)], collapse="")
  nchar(gsub("[^GCgc]","",s))/nchar(s) }
FA <- file.path(M,"data/ctrl_tf/fimo/input_fastas")
GC <- c("Trh/Tgo (ref)"=NA,
        TWI=gcf(file.path(FA,"TWI_enh_summits_200bp.fa")),
        VVL=gcf(file.path(FA,"VVL_enh_summits_200bp.fa")),
        RIB=gcf(file.path(FA,"RIB_enh_summits_200bp.fa")),
        ## Da (class I bHLH hub) is a fourth control: it is already a row of
        ## table4_ctrl_motif2_frequency.csv and of the disjoint-list test
        ## (Fig 4.8A), and its summit FASTA is scanned in the same 200 bp
        ## window as the other three.
        DA=gcf(file.path(FA,"DA_enh_summits_200bp.fa")),
        "Matched non-Tgo BG"=gcf(file.path(FA,"matched_bg_200bp.fa")))
GC["Trh/Tgo (ref)"] <- NA
enhgc <- gcf(file.path(M,"data/motif2_attribution/enh_201bp.fa"))

## KEY: both families have essentially the same internal baseline
bg_a <- pk["Matched non-Tgo BG","N_Motif2_pos"]; bg_n <- pk["Matched non-Tgo BG","N_scanned"]

rows <- list()
add <- function(lab, a, na, b, nb, fam, gc=NA){
  ft <- fisher.test(matrix(c(a,na-a,b,nb-b),2,byrow=TRUE))
  rows[[length(rows)+1]] <<- data.frame(label=lab, a=a, n=na, pct=100*a/na,
    or=unname(ft$estimate), lo=ft$conf.int[1], hi=ft$conf.int[2], p=ft$p.value,
    family=fam, gc=100*gc, stringsAsFactors=FALSE) }
for (f in c("Trh/Tgo (ref)","VVL","DA","RIB","TWI")) {
  add(f, pk[f,"N_Motif2_pos"], pk[f,"N_scanned"], bg_a, bg_n,
      "Factor peaks, vs GC/length-matched background", GC[[f]])
}
add("Enhancers bound by a heterodimer", p$a, p$n_a, p$b, p$n_b,
    "Enhancer catalogue, vs unbound enhancers", enhgc)
add("Enhancers bound by none", p$b, p$n_b, n$with_motif2, n$n,
    "Enhancer catalogue, vs unbound enhancers", enhgc)
d <- do.call(rbind, rows)
d$or <- round(d$or,2); d$lo <- round(d$lo,2); d$hi <- round(d$hi,2)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Variant C: carriage vs GC content; all sets follow one composition trend, focal sets sit above it.
## Label offsets computed from fit slope and label half-width to clear overlap; labels over 32 characters shortened.
## Row labels, colours and roles are shared with the main-text panel.
## ------------------------------------------------------------
b <- d
b$label[b$label == "Trh/Tgo (ref)"] <- "Trh/Tgo peaks"
b$label[b$label == "VVL"] <- "Vvl peaks  (POU-HD)"
b$label[b$label == "RIB"] <- "Rib peaks  (BTB-ZF)"
b$label[b$label == "TWI"] <- "Twi peaks  (bHLH, no PAS)"
## Same descriptor as the main-text attribution chunk, which already carries Da
b$label[b$label == "DA"]  <- "Da peaks  (bHLH class I, no PAS)"
b$label[b$label == "Enhancers bound by a heterodimer"] <- "Enhancers bound by a heterodimer"
b$label[b$label == "Enhancers bound by none"] <- "Enhancers bound by none"
b$role <- ifelse(grepl("Trh/Tgo", b$label), "focal_pk",
          ifelse(grepl("bound by a heterodimer", b$label), "focal_enh",
          ifelse(grepl("Enhancers", b$label), "ref_enh", "ctrl")))
b$col <- c(focal_pk = PAL_HETERO[["Trh/Tgo"]], focal_enh = M2,
           ref_enh = PAL_CONTEXT[["distal_enh"]], ctrl = NEUT)[b$role]
b$family <- factor(b$family, levels = unique(b$family))
b$label <- factor(b$label, levels = rev(b$label))
b$note <- sprintf("%.2f [%.2f\u2013%.2f]", b$or, b$lo, b$hi)
b$gcl <- ifelse(is.na(b$gc), "", sprintf("GC %.0f%%", b$gc))

cd <- b[!is.na(b$gc), ]
fit  <- lm(log10(pct) ~ gc, data = cd)
cd$resid <- residuals(fit)
slope <- abs(coef(fit)[["gc"]])                    # log10 units per %GC

cd$lab_short <- c("Vvl peaks", "Rib peaks", "Twi peaks", "Da peaks",
                  "Bound enhancers", "Unbound enhancers")[
                  match(sub("  \\(.*", "", cd$label),
                        c("Vvl peaks", "Rib peaks", "Twi peaks", "Da peaks",
                          "Enhancers bound by a heterodimer",
                          "Enhancers bound by none"))]
stopifnot(!anyNA(cd$lab_short))   # a new control with no short label would
                                  # otherwise be drawn as a blank point

## Pads halved, 1.6 -> 0.8 GC points either side. They existed to keep the
## point labels (centred on their points) inside the panel; the widest of them
## is checked against the new pad below, so a future relabelling cannot silently
## push a name off the edge.
X_LO <- min(cd$gc) - 0.8; X_HI <- max(cd$gc) + 0.8
PANEL_W_IN <- 6.3; PANEL_H_IN <- 3.05                 # plotting region, inches
Y_LO <- 5.2; Y_HI <- 52
GLYPH_IN <- (ANN - 0.5) / 72 * 0.50                   # ~0.50 em mean advance
TEXT_H_IN <- (ANN - 0.5) / 72 * 1.00
## half-width in DATA units, and one text height in log10 units
cd$half_w  <- nchar(cd$lab_short) * GLYPH_IN / PANEL_W_IN * (X_HI - X_LO) / 2
text_h_log <- TEXT_H_IN / PANEL_H_IN * (log10(Y_HI) - log10(Y_LO))
## clearance the label must have from the LINE, in text heights
need <- (slope * cd$half_w + 0.5 * text_h_log) / text_h_log
## the point is |resid| from the line already; the label needs the remainder
have <- abs(cd$resid) / text_h_log
cd$vj <- pmax(1.35, need - have + 0.9)
cd$lab_vjust <- ifelse(cd$resid > 0, -cd$vj, cd$vj)

gx <- seq(min(cd$gc), max(cd$gc), length.out = 80)
fl <- data.frame(gc = gx, pct = 10^predict(fit, data.frame(gc = gx)))

## VERIFY: for every label, the fit line's y over the label's x-extent must lie
## outside the label's own y-band. Assert; never inspect.
viol <- character()
for (k in seq_len(nrow(cd))) {
  lo <- max(cd$gc[k] - cd$half_w[k], min(gx))
  hi <- min(cd$gc[k] + cd$half_w[k], max(gx))
  if (hi <= lo) next
  yf   <- log10(10^predict(fit, data.frame(gc = c(lo, hi))))
  ## ggplot's vjust is INVERTED relative to data coordinates: a negative vjust
  ## moves text UP the panel. lab_vjust = -vj for resid > 0 therefore draws the
  ## label ABOVE its point, so the verifier adds the offset for resid > 0.
  ctr  <- log10(cd$pct[k]) + sign(cd$resid[k]) * cd$vj[k] * text_h_log
  band <- sort(c(ctr - 0.5 * text_h_log, ctr + 0.5 * text_h_log))
  if (any(yf >= band[1] & yf <= band[2])) viol <- c(viol, cd$lab_short[k])
}
if (length(viol)) stop("fit line crosses label box: ", paste(viol, collapse = ", "))
cat(sprintf("label/line check: clear for all %d labels (max offset %.1f text heights)\n",
            nrow(cd), max(cd$vj)))

pC <- ggplot(cd, aes(gc, pct)) +
  geom_line(data = fl, colour = ANNC, linetype = "22", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = I(col), size = role %in% c("focal_pk", "focal_enh"))) +
  geom_text(aes(label = lab_short, vjust = lab_vjust),
            hjust = 0.5, size = (ANN - 0.5) / .pt, colour = INK) +
  ## Shows fit statistic only, plotmath for italic R and superscript, value quoted to keep trailing zero.
  ## Positioned above dashed line, midway between Vvl and Rib strata, derived from fitted line.
  ## Bold, two points up.
  annotate("text", x = mean(sort(cd$gc)[1:2]),
           y = approx(fl$gc, fl$pct, xout = mean(sort(cd$gc)[1:2]))$y * 1.42,
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0, parse = TRUE,
           label = sprintf("italic(R)^2 == '%.2f'", summary(fit)$r.squared),
           ## INK (#333333), not ANNC (#666666): ANNC is the palette's grey for
           ## subordinate annotation (p-values, n = counts), and this is the
           ## figure's one headline number. INK is the same weight of black the
           ## axis titles and point labels already carry, so it reads as black
           ## without introducing a colour from outside the palette.
           size = (ANN + 3.5) / .pt, fontface = "bold", colour = INK) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 2.6, `TRUE` = 3.6), guide = "none") +
  ## Breaks pinned to whole GC points. Left to itself, the narrower range after
  ## the pads were halved picks 2.5-unit steps and prints 40.0 / 42.5 / 45.0 --
  ## decimals on an axis whose values are read to the unit, and a 45 tick past
  ## the data.
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(X_LO, X_HI), breaks = seq(38, 44, 2)) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(Y_LO, Y_HI), breaks = c(8, 12, 20, 40)) +
  labs(x = "Mean GC content of the scanned windows (%)",
       y = "Motif2 carriage (%)") +
  th_house()
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "figN_1_motif2_gc_confound.png"), pC,
       width = 7.6, height = 4.0, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Rebuild every figure in this file

Chunks are `eval=FALSE`, so knitting does not redraw anything. This chunk reads the
fences out of the file and evaluates them in one environment, so `setup` runs once
and every figure chunk sees it.

Do **not** use `knitr::purl()` for this: it honours `eval=FALSE` by commenting the
code out, so the extracted script runs clean and writes no figures at all — a silent
no-op that looks like success.

```{r, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE, 'Rebuild every figure in this file'}
RMD <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "04_chapter_analyses",
                 "chapter3_4_figures.Rmd")
L   <- readLines(RMD, warn = FALSE)
op  <- grep("^```\\{r", L)
cl  <- grep("^```[[:space:]]*$", L)
lab <- sub("^```\\{r[^']*'([^']*)'\\}.*$", "\\1", L[op])
lab[!grepl("'", L[op])] <- "setup"

env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
for (i in seq_along(op)) {
  if (grepl("^Rebuild", lab[i])) next          # never recurse into this chunk
  cat("---", lab[i], "\n")
  eval(parse(text = L[(op[i] + 1):(cl[cl > op[i]][1] - 1)]), envir = env)
}
cat("rebuilt", sum(!grepl("^Rebuild|^setup", lab)), "figures into", env$OUT, "\n")
```
